newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-W.P CRUSH GRIQUAS TO STAY TOP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-W.P CRUSH GRIQUAS TO STAY TOP.

text.p: Western Province crushed Griqualand West by an innings and five runs to stay on top of the Supersport Series log in Kimberley on Sunday.
Fast bowler Brett Schultz took five for 49 as Griquas were bowled out for 167 in their second innings after Province captain John Commins had completed a quickfire double century earlier in the day.
Commins resumed on his overnight 104 and, in partnership with Jacques Kallis, set about the Griquas attack in brutal style.

Commins' second 100 arrived in only 65 balls and with Kallis -- resuming his innings after recovering from mild concussion having been hit on the head by a bouncer on Saturday -- added an unbroken 120 for the sixth wicket in only 58 minutes to claim sx batting bonus points.
Needing 172 to make Province bat again Griquas began well enough putting on 45 for the first wicket before first innings centurion Martyn Gidley was lbw to Merrick Pringle.
However it was Schultz, hoping for a recall to the international squad, who hastened the home side's demise.
He blasted out four batsmen in a hostile spell either side of tea as Griquas collapsed from 110 for three to 118 for seven.
